I posted the draft in #strategic-random as a reply to your message. It has the three times from #inc-vtg-hartford, dated 2026-08-03:

- First report: 10:42 AM
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM (posted 11:08 AM)

The draft includes an open item: Mateo's account couldn't see the status page (INC-4821). Its line "were working throughout" is not supported by the source, so I posted a correction. Please use this line instead: "Scheduling still worked from the dispatch office, and Mateo's admin account could open Pemberline Dock and see today's arrivals."

The source gives no timezone for the times, so the summary should note that. I took the times from the #inc-vtg-hartford channel, which you are not in. The channel was readable to me as the assistant, and the figures contain no finance terms.
